title: Modeling & Dynamic Response Analysis of a 1-DOF Mass-Spring-Damper System
problem: n mechanical and structural engineering, understanding dynamic system behavior under transient conditions is critical for vibration control, fatigue analysis, and system stability design.I recently developed and simulated a classic Single-Degree-of-Freedom (1-DOF) Linear Mass-Spring-Damper System using Python libraries (scipy.integrate ,solve_ivp, numpy, and matplotlib) to evaluate state-space ODE numerical solutions and dynamic responses. The system is governed by the second-order linear differential equation: m*x'' + c*x' + k*x = F(t). The system exhibits underdamped free vibration. Because c > 0, energy is dissipated over time, causing the amplitude to decay exponentially towards zero. Peak amplitudes decay over time following an exponential decay e^-(wnt).
